name: export-boot
about: Both files that leave the tuner, read back at boot. Before the run, tools/devarena/run_export_boot.py writes (1) devarena's override file from the tuner-dock run's last override line (3 versions, live v3 in B, one pin) and (2) a vanilla-tuning export with ran_mark cooldown 1234 and castpoint 77. It restores both committed defaults afterwards. The tuner must come back on v3 (Entangle castpoint 100, L5 area-dmg 81), and vanilla-tuning must patch ran_mark with no devarena involvement.
